originalTitle: KINGDOM HEARTS IV | D23 2026 Showcase Trailer
content: Revealed during the Disney Entertainment Showcase on August 14, 2026, KINGDOM HEARTS IV is launching in late 2027! A brand-new adventure awaits as the world of Disney and Pixar's Coco joins KINGDOM HEARTS IV.
